name: OnePlus U Series 65U1S 164 cm (65 inch) 4K LED Smart TV
shortDescription: OnePlus TV 65 U1S: 164 cm (65 inch) 4K LED Android TV with HDR10+, 30 W Dolby Audio sound and Google Assistant built in.
description:
The OnePlus TV 65 U1S is a 164 cm (65 inch) 4K (3840 x 2160) LED smart TV with a DCI-P3 93% colour gamut and support for HDR10+, HDR10 and HLG. OnePlus's Gamma Engine handles MEMC, upscaling and noise reduction.

It runs Android TV 10 with Google Assistant built in, Chromecast built-in, hands-free voice control and OnePlus Connect 2.0, and has 2 GB RAM and 16 GB storage. Sound comes from a 30 W, 2.0-channel, four-unit speaker system with Dolby Audio, co-tuned with Dynaudio.

Ports include three HDMI 2.1 inputs (one with eARC), two USB 2.0 ports, Ethernet, optical audio out and an RF input. A stand and a wall mount are in the box.
